title: Winston-Salem/Forsyth Co. Planning & Zoning
lastAction: Ref To Com On Rules, Calendar, and Operations of the House
aiSummary: This bill allows the City of Winston-Salem to delegate rezoning decisions to the joint City-County Planning Board, while keeping appeal rights and final review authority with the City Council. The bill also clarifies zoning procedures and permits density bonuses for affordable housing development.
aiProArguments: Supporters argue this bill streamlines the rezoning process by allowing the Planning Board to handle routine decisions, reducing delays and making development faster. It also keeps important safeguards by requiring City Council approval of appeals and final decisions, ensuring local elected officials retain control over major zoning changes.
aiConArguments: Opponents may contend that delegating rezoning authority to an unelected Planning Board reduces direct democratic accountability, since residents cannot vote out Planning Board members. They might also worry this could lead to inconsistent zoning decisions or that the appeal process may become burdensome, effectively limiting residents' ability to challenge unfavorable rezoning decisions.
